messages:
marta (eng): RC candidate rc-2026-03-21-3 built and ready. artifacts: https://ci.internal.redwood/artifacts/rc3. PR for notes: https://git.internal.redwood/releases/pulls/412
kevin (sheriff): quick smoke on canary would be great. I can sheriff the window.
deploy-bot: CI: smoke OK. image pushed gcr.redwood/rc3:2026-03-21. KV warm set to 5m.
lia (pm): QA: green except flaky rerank test, marked non-blocker. Known issue added to notes.
sam (release-czar): checklist: pin, warm, canary, evals, promote. who pins?
marta (eng): pinned SHA a1b2c3d4 via `/release pin a1b2c3d4`.
ops-oncall: change window 14:00-14:30 UTC is fine. monitoring on.
kevin (sheriff): KV warm done. smoke curl returns 200 and expected tokens.
sam (release-czar): starting 10% canary at 14:05. runbook: https://confluence/redwood/release-runbook
marta (eng): `/deploy canary rc3 --percent 10`
deploy-bot: Canary started 10% traffic, health OK.
kevin (sheriff): 10m in, no error spike, latency stable.
marta (eng): bumping to 50% now `/deploy canary rc3 --percent 50`
deploy-bot: Canary at 50%, health OK.
kevin (sheriff): eval pass rate 98.7% vs baseline 98.9. slight dip but tolerable.
sam (release-czar): decision: promote with rollback guard or hold.
lia (pm): low user impact, proceed and notify support.
marta (eng): rollback target a1b2c3d3 if needed. cmd `/deploy rollback a1b2c3d3 --force`
kevin (sheriff): I'll sherif for 30m post-promo. thumbs?
lia (pm): :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: :thumbsup:
kevin (sheriff): :thumbsup:
marta (eng): promoting `/deploy promote rc3 --to prod --note "rc3: embeddings fallback known-issue"`
deploy-bot: Promotion staged 10->25->50->100%. estimated 12m.
ops-oncall: small tokenization bump on one shard but within SLO.
kevin (sheriff): metrics steady, no 5xx spike.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete: 100% -> a1b2c3d4.
sam (release-czar): publish notes and notify early-access.
marta (eng): notes published, artifacts pinned, changelog pushed. monitoring 30m.
kevin (sheriff): handing off sheriff duty at 14:55 UTC. all clear so far.
ops-oncall: will continue 1h monitoring.
sam (release-czar): closing thread. ping if regressions. :tada:
